text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I managed to finish first.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: The moment I crossed the finish line, with all the cheers washing over me… The sense of accomplishment was utterly indescribable.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: And I've no doubt in my mind that it's thanks to your support I was able to enjoy such an experience, Trainer. Thank you, from the bottom of my heart.
choice_data_list: You shone like a star out there!
Don't get too complacent. Let's set our sights on the next race!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Hehe! I'm quite confident that my running today will live on in the hearts and minds of those who came to watch.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Thank you. I shall strive to fill your memory with many more great races, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yes. I very much wish to experience the sensation of crossing that finish line in first again.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Please continue to provide me with your guidance and support.
